$comment: VAPP-110 Exponential apps ×4 (web routes/t/$teamSlug/apps/*, desktop crates/ui apps screens, iOS Apps/*, Android ui/apps/*). An APP = a team-scoped declarative package (the Exponential UI SDK's format: manifest + A2UI templates + bindings + a function allowlist, data never code) rendered by the Exponential UI renderers through the client's app host (`exp:` bindings over the synced store, `harness.*` functions behind the consent card, the URL policy). ONE look ×4. THE LIST (`apps` view; VAPP-242: PHONES ONLY = the Apps tab (web < md alike); web ≥ md, the IDE and Settings have NO Apps list page and no Apps nav row: the sidebar's APPS group lists the apps, see DESKTOP NAV): a Section band `copy.title` whose trailing action pill `copy.newApp` (ui-add, testId `newApp`) opens THE NEW MENU, then ListRows = BoardGlyph (icon + colour, the board set) + name (medium) + the version pill = `listPill` (V1, #VAPP-210: the PUBLISHED version `copy.version` `v{n}`; `copy.noVersion` = the DRAFT badge, muted, while published_version = 0) + a trailing `…` menu (`copy.menu.*`, `run.menu`: Edit app (`copy.menu.edit`, ui-edit, the creator or an owner) = THE EDITOR, Export (published > 0), Delete → the confirm prompt `copy.deleteTitle`/`copy.deleteBody`, members may delete only their own apps, owners every app; no Rename: the agent names an app, the settings page renames it). Exponential ships NO built-in apps (2026-10-24): the list is the team's synced apps only. Rows sort by name (case-insensitive). A TAP on a row RUNS the app (THE RUN VIEW, pushed), never the editor. Empty (a team with no apps): the list-size EmptyState `copy.empty` under the band. THE NEW MENU (VAPP-242, testId `newMenu`): every apps `+` (the sidebar group's `+`, the IDE rail's `+`, the phone list band's pill) opens THE existing Menu (no new component) with `run.newMenu` in order: `copy.newApp` (ui-add) = NEW APP, then `copy.import` (ui-file) = IMPORT. NEW APP (VAPP-176, EDITOR-FIRST, no dialog, no form, no `/settings/apps/new`): EVERY New app entry (THE NEW MENU's first item, the settings nav's `@new-app`) calls tRPC `apps.create {teamId}` with NO other field = a DRAFT named `copy.untitled` (slug `slugify(copy.untitled)` de-duplicated with `-2`, `-3`; no icon, no colour; head_version 0) and opens its editor at once. A DRAFT = an app with no version yet (head_version 0); its version pill reads `copy.noVersion` (`Draft`). THE AGENT NAMES IT: a draft's editor brief tells the editor session to pass name, icon, colour and description on its first `apps upsert`; a rename while the app is still a draft (that upsert, or the settings page) RE-DERIVES the slug from the new name (`slugify`, the app's own slug not counted as taken), so every editor keys the app by ID and follows a slug change in place (web: the route is replaced). CLEANUP: leaving the editor of an EMPTY draft (no version and no editor session, i.e. nothing was ever sent) calls tRPC `apps.discardDraft {id}`, which hard-deletes it only when it is still empty and the caller created it (anything else = a no-op), so abandoned drafts never pile up. IMPORT (app-export.json) = THE NEW MENU's second item `copy.import` (the import dialog on web ≥ md + the IDE, the sheet on phones); an imported app opens its editor. THE EDITOR (`app` view, route `/t/$teamSlug/app-editor/$appSlug` (VAPP-242: `run.editorPath`), VAPP-177 `editorTabs`; reached ONLY from the sidebar row's hover gear, the `…` › `copy.menu.edit` of a phone list row or THE RUN VIEW, the Settings nav's `@apps` rows, NEW APP and IMPORT; a plain row click RUNS the app): header (#EXP-1729: `editorHeader`; phones = THE chat header) = BoardGlyph + name over its `status · device` subtitle + the version pill (`listPill`, web ≥ md and desktop) + PUBLISH (V1, #VAPP-210: on web ≥ md and desktop a small primary Button `copy.publish` before the tabs, on phones the FIRST item of the `…` menu (icon `ui-submit`), testId `publish`, while `canPublish` and the viewer may write the app (access `write`) = tRPC `apps.publish {id}` → toast `copy.publishedToast`, a failure = the failed-action toast); on web ≥ md and desktop the header ends in a SegmentedControl of `editorTabs.wide` (VAPP-178 adds Data: Preview | Data | Versions | Settings; phones Chat | Preview | Data; the DATA tab = app-records.json `dataTab`) (`copy.tabs.*`, testId `tabs`) and the BODY = two panes, the chat `panes.chat` : the TAB pane `panes.preview` (fr), a hairline between (the chat pane has no header strip of its own); the editor opens on `editorTabs.default` (no tab is kept), a deep link `?tab=<id>` (web) or the settings nav (desktop) opens that tab. Phones (and web < md): a SegmentedControl of `editorTabs.phone` under the header, ONE pane (opens on `editorTabs.phoneDefault`), and the header's trailing `…` menu (testId `menu`) = `editorTabs.menu` (`copy.menu.*`): Versions (the count as trailing meta) and Settings open THE SAME tab bodies as a sheet titled by the item, Export (head > 0 only) the export sheet, Delete app (destructive; the creator or an owner) the delete confirm prompt; a phone deep link to `versions`/`settings` opens that sheet over the Chat tab. A DRAFT's editor: the two panes as always on web ≥ md and desktop, the Chat tab on phones; while its chat is empty the chat pane shows the page-size EmptyState (`copy.starterTitle`, the app glyph) whose actions are one `mode: action` Pill per `copy.starters` entry (a tap SENDS that text as the first message, disabled like the composer without a device), the composer is FOCUSED and its placeholder is `copy.draftPlaceholder`; the preview pane = the page-size EmptyState `copy.previewEmpty`. CHAT = the member's EDITOR SESSION with the app (a root with `sessions.app_id` + `user_id` = me): the same channel rows as a team agent's conversation (ChannelMessageRow: avatar / the app glyph, name, time, body; cards answer in place) and THE composer (`copy.composerPlaceholder`); no session yet = the same pane, empty, whose composer's first send is `sessions.send({appId, text, deviceId})` (the device = EDITOR DEVICE below; none online = the composer disabled with `copy.noDevice`). `copy.chatEmpty` sits in the empty chat. EDITOR DEVICE (#FEED-204, `editorDevice`, `editorDeviceCases`): the composer's `+` carries THE launch composer's Device › row (composer-menu.json `device`, surfaces `session`/`agent`, no new component: THE device picker's rows, value = the device's name) over the member's online devices (with an editor root: minus the targets session-device-move.json refuses). `editorDevice(root, candidates, remembered)`: no root or an ENDED root = free to change: the REMEMBERED pick when it is a candidate, else the ended root's own device, else the default device, else the first candidate, else the ended root's device (nothing online; the send waits there as it always did). A LIVE root (queued, idle, running: anything not ended): the row stays enabled and names the root's device; a remembered device never moves it (#EXP-1738), a PICK does, at once: session-device-move.json's bare `sessions.send({sessionId, deviceId})` (picking its current device does nothing, a refusal = that picker's failed-action toast), which re-queues the SAME row on the target (`applyDirectMove`, #EXP-1737); the pick is remembered like any other. `move` = an ended root's next send goes elsewhere: that send is `sessions.send({appId, text, deviceId})` (`messageApp` → `reviveRoot` re-targets the row and says so in the chat, and the brief rides again for the new device), every other send to an existing root stays `{sessionId}`. A pick is remembered per app on THIS client (web localStorage `exp.apps.editorDevice.<appId>`, iOS UserDefaults, Android SharedPreferences, desktop ui_prefs), never in `devices.setDefault`; a remembered device that is offline is kept and simply loses to the fallbacks until it is back. Starters send on the same device. LIFETIME: entering the editor starts nothing; leaving it (route change, tab close) ENDS the member's live editor session (`sessions.end` on the root: the tree); the next send revives the same root (FEED-134: the row goes idle again with its context, so the chat is that root's messages). DRAFT VS PUBLISHED (V1, #VAPP-210, spec §2.3): every version write (`apps upsert`, Restore) makes a new HEAD = the editor's DRAFT and never changes what members run; `apps.package` is the PUBLISHED version's package (`published_version`; 0 = never published) and `apps.draft_package` the head's while the head is ahead (NULL when head = published, so the head's package is `draft_package ?? package`). Members, the exposed MCP tools (the broker) and automations run the PUBLISHED package; PUBLISH (the header button, a Versions row's button, the viewing banner, MCP `apps publish {version?}`) moves the pointer to any version (an older one = a rollback). An imported app file and an app created WITH a package (MCP `apps upsert` on a new slug) are published at once (v1); every later version is a draft. Records validate against the published kind schema, or the draft's while a draft exists (an editor seeds new kinds). PREVIEW = which version: `shownVersion` (`publishCases`): an explicitly viewed version (Versions › Preview), else nothing (head 0), else the HEAD while the viewer's own editor session is live (not ended) or nothing is published, else the PUBLISHED version; it renders that package's first template (VAPP-179: `previewTemplates`, see `preview.$comment`) (`applyTemplate`, surface id = the slug) in a frame `preview.radius` px / `preview.padding` px with the theme's background; the apps shape carries both packages, so every MCP `apps upsert` repaints the editing member's preview live. No version yet: the page-size EmptyState `copy.previewEmpty` in the frame. The HostBanner (offline / catalog update) sits above the surface; the consent card is the client's. VERSIONS (VAPP-177: the `versions` TAB on web ≥ md and desktop, the menu's sheet on phones; none yet = the list-size EmptyState `copy.versionsEmpty`): ONE grouped list (testId `versions`), rows newest first = the `copy.version` pill (`v{n}`) + `note` (`copy.noNote` muted when empty) over a muted caption `who · relative time` (a person's name, or `copy.byAgent`); trailing (`versionRow`): the PUBLISHED row = the `copy.published` badge; the HEAD row while ahead of it = the `copy.head` badge + a `copy.publish` outline button (testId `versionPublish`); every other row = a `copy.preview` ghost button (testId `versionPreview`) + a `copy.publish` outline button (testId `versionPublish`). PREVIEW switches to the Preview tab (phones: closes the sheet, the Preview tab) showing that version: a banner `copy.viewing` with `copy.publish` (not on the published version), `copy.restore` (not on the head) and `copy.head` (back to the preview's default) above the surface; RESTORE (the row's button or the banner's) = tRPC `apps.restore` → a NEW head version `copy.restoredNote` (`Restored v{n}`), toast `copy.restored`, the preview back on the head. CAPS: contract `apps` (slug, name, description, note, package bytes, components per template). RECORDS (VAPP-122, fixtures/app-records.json): an app keeps its own data as records (`records: {<kind>: {schema}}` in the manifest; `records:<kind>?…` reads them live, `records.upsert/delete` write them, no consent card); the editor's SETTINGS tab (×4, VAPP-177) shows the count as one muted line under the description: `recordsCountLabel` (`copy.records*`: `1,240 records`, with the plan quota `1,240 of 25,000 records`, `No records`); the quota (plan-limits `appRecords`, cloud only) refuses a write with the plan-limit error, shown as a toast. TOOLS (VAPP-120, fixtures/app-actions.json): every MCP operation is a typed host function `exponential.<noun>.<op>`; the editor's SETTINGS tab (×4) shows a `copy.tools` group under the records line: `copy.tools.title` with `copy.tools.hint`, one ListRow per function the PUBLISHED package declares (the head's while nothing is published; V1) (the display title + the function name muted + a Switch = the grant, a team OWNER only, disabled for everyone else; a destructive action shows `copy.tools.always` in place of the switch: it can never be granted), `copy.tools.none` when it declares none; `apps.granted_tools` syncs on the apps shape; a switch writes the whole list WITH the version on screen (`apps.update {grantedTools, headVersion}`, VAPP-156; the field carries `grantVersion` = the published version, else the head): a version published meanwhile refuses with CONFLICT; the grants follow the published package (an owner's publish keeps the still-declared ones, anyone else's clears them) (the failed-action toast), the row resyncs and the owner grants again; a granted call runs without the consent card, an ungranted or destructive one asks with the operation's words. FEEDBACK: a failed create/delete/restore = toast (feedback-states.json); an invalid name inline. Model = pure `apps.ts` (TS reference): every mirror replays `slugifyCases`, `versionLabelCases`, `sortAppsCases` and `publishCases`. DESKTOP NAV (web ≥ md + the IDE rail): no plain Apps nav row; an APPS sidebar GROUP drawn exactly like Agents and Boards, between them: the label `copy.title` (VAPP-242: NOT clickable, there is no Apps page), a `+` group action = THE NEW MENU, one compact row per app (its glyph in its colour + name → THE RUN VIEW, the active row while it runs), the hover gear (#FEED-203: EVERY member, every row; keyboard focus reveals it too; read-only below the creator or an owner, as THE SETTINGS TAB says) → THE EDITOR on its Settings tab. SETTINGS mirrors Agents: the settings nav's `Apps` group lists the apps (`@apps`, each → THE EDITOR on its Settings tab) + `@new-app` (= New app: a draft, its editor); VAPP-242: NO index page (Settings → Apps and the phones' Team-page Apps row are gone, settings-nav.json). THE SETTINGS TAB (VAPP-177, testId `settings`): the identity row (icon + colour + name, the name a deferred write), the description card (saved on blur), the records line, the RECORD ACCESS group (#VAPP-243, `policyRowCases`: each declared kind's effective policy, read-only), the Tools group (the grant switches, an owner only), the ACCOUNTS group and the MCP TOOLS group (#VAPP-243, `accountRowCases`: the viewer's own upstream connections with Connect / Reconnect, and the exposed tools' per-tool switch, an owner only), the AUTOMATIONS group (#VAPP-220, testId `automations`, shown when the PUBLISHED package declares automations; everyone reads it, nothing to switch: one row per automation (testId `automationRow`), title = its name, a second line = `automationRow(row).trigger` (#VAPP-243: + ` · ` + `automationSponsor(row)`, WHO it runs as or why it is paused, `automationSponsorCases`), a trailing Pill = `automationRow(row).label`; the rows come from tRPC `appAccess.appTools` `automations`, `automationRowCases`), then a row with `copy.menu.export` (head > 0) and `copy.menu.delete` (destructive, at the end; the creator or an owner) → the delete prompt, which leaves for the team's home (phones: the Apps tab); at most `editorTabs.settingsMaxWidth` px wide on web ≥ md and desktop. Everyone else sees it read-only. Phones get it (grants included) as the menu's Settings sheet. (VAPP-176: no create mode). PHONES: the Apps LIST is the APPS TAB (chats.json `shell.tabs`, #EXP-1379), a top-level page under the shared page header (`copy.title`, search + inbox circles); its `copy.newApp` pill (THE NEW MENU) stays on the Section band. VAPP-242: a tap RUNS the app (THE RUN VIEW pushed over the tab); the editor sits behind the row's / the run view's `…` › `copy.menu.edit`. VAPP-129's FLOATING layout (the chat in THE Dock over the preview, its per-device `exp.apps.editorLayout`, Move to the side / Minimize) is GONE since VAPP-177: the chat is always docked beside the tabs. TEMPLATES (VAPP-234, app-templates.json): a draft's starters end in one more pill `Start from a template` opening the import dialog/sheet, whose templates step imports a signed template as a finished app (v1 published) and opens its editor. VAPP-221: `appFiles` = the app hosts' FileUpload uploads (files on records). THE RUN VIEW (VAPP-242, Danny 2026-11-03; testId `run`; web routes `/t/$teamSlug/apps/$appSlug` and `/t/$teamSlug/apps/$appSlug/$screen?<params>`, desktop + natives the `appRun` route): the app as a member uses it, FULL SCREEN. It runs the PUBLISHED package (`apps.package`, never the draft, never Run as; `published_version` 0 = the page-size EmptyState `copy.runEmpty` with the app glyph, centred) through THE SAME app host and pieces as the editor's PREVIEW (no fork: records with `me` = the viewer, the published grants `granted_tools`, the app access level (`read` = the eUI readOnly paint), the HostBanner, the consent card, uploads, the media rule) and the `screens` shell (`screenShell(n, phone)` with `phone` = the device is a phone or web < md; no screens = the package's first template by id). No preview toolbar, no frame chooser, no template Select. LAYOUT: the surface fills the content area edge to edge (no frame border or radius; `preview.padding` inside the surface pane; the shell's sidebar column / phone tab bar as in the preview). Web ≥ md + the IDE: no header of its own (the sidebar's app row is the active one). Phones + web < md: the detail header (back, BoardGlyph + the app's name, a trailing `…` menu testId `runMenu` = `run.menu`: `copy.menu.edit` (the creator or an owner) → THE EDITOR, `copy.menu.export` (published > 0), `copy.menu.delete` (the creator or an owner, destructive) → the delete prompt). PHONES + web < md: every apps `…` and THE NEW MENU open THE Menu's bottom sheet titled by the app's name (THE NEW MENU: `copy.newApp`), never a popover. WHICH SCREEN = the preview's rule (`resolveScreen`; a repaint on a new published version keeps the screen when it still exists). `app.navigate`: on web REPLACES the route with `screenPath` (history replace); desktop + natives keep it in memory. DEEP LINKS (`screenPath`, app-link.json `appScreen`) land HERE; an old web link `/t/$teamSlug/apps/$appSlug?tab=<id>` (the editor's former path) REPLACES itself with THE EDITOR on that tab. A slug change follows in place like the editor (keyed by id). A PACKAGE THAT NO LONGER VALIDATES (#VAPP-251: published before a validator rule tightened, or a catalog change): it never takes the shell down, THE RUN VIEW and THE EDITOR's preview alike. `surfaceState(hasPackage, applied, hasSurface)` (`surfaceStateCases`) = `needsUpdate` once the host had its chance and holds no surface (the host refused the package or the template made nothing; web also: ANY throw while building or painting the surface, an error boundary per preview that resets when the package changes, so a republished package repaints without a reload, and catches nothing of the shell around it). The pane then shows ONLY the page-size EmptyState `copy.needsUpdate` with the app glyph, centred, no screens shell and no host banner; the sidebar, header and tabs stay, and the `…` menu keeps working. The validator's message never reaches the screen: it goes to the client's log. A guest gets `copy.gone` (app-share.json).

preview.$comment: VAPP-179 (web ≥ md + desktop; phones unchanged) THE PREVIEW TOOLBAR: one row above the viewing banner and the surface (testId `previewToolbar`): at its start a SegmentedControl `copy.frame.*` (`preview.frames`, testId `previewFrame`; opens on `preview.defaultFrame`, kept for the editor's lifetime only) = the frame's width: Desktop = the pane's full width, Phone = `preview.phoneWidth` px centred in the pane (the same frame, radius and padding); at its end, ONLY when the shown package (the head, or the version being viewed) has more than one template, a Select (testId `previewTemplate`) of `previewTemplates(pkg)` = the template ids sorted by name (a host's JSON layer, Postgres JSONB included, does not keep the declared order), each option the id itself; the surface renders the picked template (`applyTemplate`), the default = the first of that list (`templateCases`); a picked id the next package lacks falls back to the default. Every renderer is the same one, so a template looks the same in both frames apart from the width. #VAPP-252 THE LAYERS, preview and run view alike: a package's Dialog and Drawer leave the surface and its frame: the scrim covers the whole window (tab bar, sidebar, header), a Dialog centres in it, a Drawer hangs from its edge, popups opened inside them move with them. Phones place them in the safe area above the keyboard, the fields stay reachable. #VAPP-253 a top or bottom sheet spans the whole window on every platform: the host hands the core the window's size (the core's layer viewport; web's fixed overlay needs none), the sheet's content stays clear of the safe area. Menus, popovers and tooltips on the surface stay anchored in it.

mediaPolicy.$comment: VAPP-157 (the 2026-10-28 ruling) THE APP HOSTS' MEDIA RULE ×4: an Exponential app's Image / Avatar / Video / Audio src and markdown image loads ONLY when it is (a) a `data:` url whose mime is image/*, audio/* or video/* except image/svg+xml (scheme and mime case-insensitive), or (b) the instance's own attachment, `/api/attachments/<uuid>` relative or absolute on the instance's exact origin (scheme, host case-insensitive, port), the RAW path exactly that (no dot segments, no percent-encoding, no trailing segment), no query, no fragment, no credentials, no surrounding whitespace. Anything else loads nothing (the SDK's existing denied-src rendering: no request, no new UI), so bound team data can never ride a url to another host. The web, desktop, iOS and Android app hosts narrow the SDK's media policy with it (`appMediaAllowed(src, origin)`; a host narrows, never widens); the SDK's own generic default and the link policy are unchanged. `cases` replay ×4 against `origin`.

editorHeader.$comment: #EXP-1729 (#EDE-63, draft-ios-app-editor): THE EDITOR's header says why nothing starts, `status · device` like every chat header (chats.json `shell.chatHeader` subtitle, the chat's `state · device`). `editorHeader(root, device)` (`editorHeaderCases`, every mirror compares the WHOLE value): `root` = the member's editor root ({status, busy, needsInput}) or null; `device` = THE device the composer shows (`editorDevice`'s pick; null = none) with its name (the device label, else its id) and whether it is online. The WORD: none without a root or with an ENDED one; else `copy.needsInput` while needsInput, else `copy.working` while busy, else `copy.queued` while status is queued, else none. The DEVICE part: its name while online, else `copy.noDeviceOnline` (none, or offline). subtitle = the word and the device part joined by ` · ` (never empty: the device part always shows). TONE: `attention` (the needs-input amber) while it needs input or the device part is `copy.noDeviceOnline`; else `active` (the foreground) while busy or queued; else `muted` (the chat header's default subtitle colour). PHONES (iOS, Android, web < md): the editor's header IS THE chat header (no new component): back · the lead disc (the chat header's `disc` on the muted fill) carrying the app's BoardGlyph at `discGlyph` · the app's name over this subtitle in its tone · `…` (the editor menu, Publish its first item as before); the version pill leaves the phone header (draft 5). WIDE (web ≥ md, desktop): the header row keeps BoardGlyph · name · version pill · Publish · the tabs; the name becomes the chat header's title block, the name over this subtitle (`shell.chatHeader.subtitle` px, the same tone). THE COMPOSER is the session composer: its `+` carries Device, Account and Model (composer-menu.json `device`/`account`/`model`, an app editor's composer: THE launch composer's picker rows, no new component). Without a root, Account and Model seed from the editor device's launch defaults (the launch composer's own seeding: the device's last login, that agent's default model); an ENDED root's rows read its OWN account and model and offer only its agent's logins and models (a revive keeps the agent); a pick rides the next send together with the picked login's agent (`sessions.send({appId, text, deviceId, cli, account, model})`, `messageApp` → `runnerFields` / `reviveRoot`'s `runnerPicks`); a LIVE root reads its own account and model and a pick is the session's own switch (`sessions.send({sessionId, account})`, `sessions.send({sessionId, model})`) under its existing rules. Picks are held while the editor is open (only the device is remembered, `editorDevice`).

runAs.$comment: VAPP-198 (eApps R3, spec §11) RUN AS <member>: in THE PREVIEW TOOLBAR (`preview`: web ≥ md + desktop; phones have no toolbar, so no Run as), for a team OWNER only, a Select (testId `previewRunAs`) after the frame control: `runAsOptions(members, me, role)` = null (no Select) unless the viewer is an owner and the team has another member; else `copy.runAs.me` (value "") first, then every OTHER member by name (case-insensitive, then id; no name = the id). Picking a member renders the preview AS them: the host's `me` is them, a `records:` binding reads only the rows their team role and their app access may read (packages/exponential-ui fixtures/record-policy.json `readable`; the owner's device holds every row), and every write or host call (records.*, actions' writes, MCP and typed actions) is refused with the toast `copy.runAs.writesOff` ({name} = their name) and does nothing: a preview never writes as someone else. `exp:` sources stay the owner's (the preview cannot read another member's issues). Switching apps or leaving the editor drops back to Me.

appFiles.$comment: VAPP-221 (eApps R7, spec docs/spec/apps.md §3.3) THE APP HOSTS' FILE UPLOAD ×4. A record field with `format: "attachment"` holds `/api/attachments/<id>` (eUI `validateRecord`); a package fills it from a FileUpload whose `files` is bound. When files reach a FileUpload of an app surface (web `HostPlugin.onUpload`, desktop `on_upload`, iOS `onUpload`, Android the host's `pickFiles`), the web, desktop, iOS and Android app hosts POST each file's bytes, one at a time in the picked order, as ONE multipart part named `partName` (the file's name and type) to `uploadPath` (`{appId}` = the app) on the instance, as the viewer. The answer is `{id, url, filename, contentType, sizeBytes, width, height}`; the host then writes `url` into the list at the FileUpload's bound `files` path: `uploadTarget(components, name)` = the absolute path of the FIRST FileUpload (component order) whose `name` (else its id) equals the upload's field name and whose `files` is a `{path}` binding starting with `/` (a relative path, a literal or no binding = null: nothing is written, the upload still happens), and `withUploadedUrl(list, fileName, url)` = the list with `url` set on EVERY object entry whose `name` is `fileName` (other keys kept, other entries untouched), or null when the value is no list or no entry has that name (nothing to write). The web drop zone stays busy until the uploads settle (the promise `onUpload` returns). A refused upload (the caps, the storage budget, read access) or a network error = the failed-action toast (feedback-states.json) `failedVerb` `failedThing`, the file stays listed without a url (the record write then names it). Under Run as (VAPP-198) and at app access `read` (the FileUpload paints disabled, VAPP-200) nothing uploads. No new UI: the FileUpload's own list shows the files.

screens.$comment: VAPP-218 (eApps U1, spec docs/spec/apps.md §5.1; the eUI half = @exponential_app/eui src/host/screens.ts, fixtures/host-router.json `screens` + `navigate`): a package's `screens` are painted BY THE HOST inside THE PREVIEW FRAME with EXISTING navigation components only (no new component): `screenShell(screenCount, phone)` (#EXP-1674: `screenCount` = the screens in the NAVIGATION, eUI `navScreens`: the shell leaves `nav: false` detail screens out; one shows with no row or tab selected) = null when the package declares no screens (the frame shows the picked template as before), `bar` when `phone` (the device is a phone, web < md, OR the preview's Phone frame), else `sidebar`. SIDEBAR (wide frame): the styleguide `sidebar-rows` compact rows (the screen's eUI icon by name, unknown/none = `ui-icon-placeholder`, + its title; the shown screen = the active row) in a column `sidebarWidth` px wide at the frame's start, a hairline, then the surface; testId `previewScreens`. BAR (phone frame, phones): the styleguide `phone-tab-bar` under the surface inside the frame, one item per screen (icon + title, the shown one selected); testId `previewScreens`. A tap opens that screen with its own params. SWIPE (#FEED-201): in the BAR the surface pane pages between the NAVIGATION screens exactly like every phone tab strip, with THE pager (web `useFaceSwipe`, iOS `FacePager`, Android `TabPager`; neighbour pages drawn where that pager draws them, its fling, its reduced-motion rule): a settled swipe opens the neighbour screen with its own params and the bar selects it; a touch that starts inside eUI content that scrolls, pans or drags sideways keeps its gesture (web: eUI `swipeBlocked`; natives: nested scroll). A shown detail screen (`nav: false`) does not page; the sidebar never pages. WHICH SCREEN: eUI `resolveScreen(pkg, requested, params)` (the requested one, else the first; its params then the request's); `app.navigate` (`HostOptions.navigate`) replaces the request (screen + params); a repaint (a new head, Versions › Preview) keeps it when the next package has that screen, else the first. The surface opens the screen's template with `applyTemplate` data `{params}` (eUI `screenData`). With screens the toolbar's template Select (`previewTemplate`) is hidden: the screens ARE the picker. DEEP LINKS (VAPP-242: they open THE RUN VIEW on that screen, never the editor): web route `/t/$teamSlug/apps/$appSlug/$screen` whose query is the params: `screenPath(teamSlug, appSlug, screen, params)` = the path, `encodeURIComponent` per segment, then `?` + the params sorted by key as `k=v` pairs (encodeURIComponent both), none = no `?`; `screenParamsFromQuery(query)` = every key but `reserved` (the editor's own `tab`, `frame`). In THE RUN VIEW on web a navigate REPLACES the route with `screenPath` (history replace, not push); the editor's preview, desktop and the natives keep it in memory. Natives + desktop: app-link.json `appScreen` (a tapped link, a universal / app link) opens THE RUN VIEW showing that screen. Locked ×4 by `screenShellCases`, `screenPathCases`, `screenQueryCases` (web lib apps.ts, desktop domain::apps, iOS ExpCore Apps.swift, Android domain/Apps.kt).
